number of software packages they want to purchase.
But this is not unusual for them. You'll need to be
careful in working with them.

How about 2:30 at Cha Cha Grill?

Thomas to give you any information he has on that
account. He was the lead salesperson before you, and
I'm sure he can fill you in on the challenges he faced.
Amihan Mendoza [1:36 p.m.]
OK. I'll see you there.
